decisions.reason: As an adjacent but relatively narrow digital add-on for aviation customers, the mobile app likely faced weak post-launch feedback in the pandemic-hit airport market, and a large security firm using behavioral rules would reallocate resources if results stayed below aspiration.

The passenger processing technology line had the clearest launch signal and strongest fit with the firm's strategic push into integrated high-end security solutions, so with organisational slack and recovery expectations management would likely continue it despite short-term uncertainty.

The self-service airline check-in solution is strategically related to the firm's airport offering and could improve client efficiency, so even if performance was mixed, management would likely keep it a bit longer while monitoring whether results recover toward aspiration levels.
